doc: M2-RND-03 battle VFX library: effect definitions and what triggers them. BattleVfx (game/vfx/battle/battle_vfx.gd) listens to the engine and plays them; it never writes combat state. docs/kb/tech/battle_vfx.md. Colours are palette.json swatches (named in `swatches`, tested).

safety.doc: Photosensitivity: every flash is capped at flash_max_alpha, and two flashes are at least flash_min_interval_s apart (at most 2 a second, under WCAG 2.3.1's 3). Flashes draw on a CanvasLayer below the HUD, so the timeline is never covered (pillar 4).

reduced_motion.doc: UiSettings.reduced_motion(): fewer, slower particles, no turbulence, and a flash at a third of its alpha with a gentle ramp.

lamp_dive.note: Rhen's Swell (Lamp Dive): the lamp's oil light splashing up from the dive point. It burns oil, never glimmer (decisions_log N-02).

shallows_verse.note: Asha's Swell heal: shallow-water light lapping up around each ally (water, not glimmer).

read.note: Read: a still ring of gold points around the read foe.

status_apply.note: A status added to the target.

ko_release.note: KO: the fighter dissolves into released glimmer rising in slow spirals, 0.15-0.4 m/s (color_script.md rule 1). M3-BPR-420 (ADR 0041, arena self-render): the core flash trimmed from 1.8-2.2 m to 0.9-1.15 m; at battle distance it had bleached the fighters beside the fallen one.

toll_gather.note: The toll gathering: held motes drawn down over the hood toward the rim (held: down, never rising; color_script.md rule 1).

rim_crack.note: A landed weak-point hit on the rim: a spray of struck sparks.

rim_break.note: The rim breaks (charge broken): a cyan burst; the toll is lost.

polyp_rise.note: A spawn-polyp roused: a cyan swirl at its foot, settling back down.

polyp_mend.note: Held motes flowing from the polyp to the bell (aimed at play time); sinking, never rising.

bell_release.note: The bell dies: its motes slide seaward and down; they do not rise (vertical_slice.md section 5).

flash_toll.note: The toll: a pale pulse (photosensitivity-capped like every flash).

quick_hit.note: Rhen: a quick light cut, foam-white.

undertow_cut.note: Rhen: a cut that drags down like the undertow: teal spray pulled under.

mend.note: Asha: shallow water lifting off the wound (water, not glimmer).

hasten.note: Asha: quick pale streaks rising past the ally.

ward.note: Asha: a ring of reef-blue light lifting around the ally.

shell_breaker.note: Toma: shell plates cracking off the target.

hold_the_stair.note: Toma (Ch8): he sets his shield over the stair.

challenge.note: Toma (Ch8): the challenge, a spark at the foe's head.

stand_fast.note: Ch8: a hero braces on the wall-walk.

ember.note: Ysolde: a small flame climbing the target.

frost.note: Ysolde: salt-glass shards of rime falling.

slow_hex.note: Ysolde: ink-dark motes settling over the target.

fluke_cleave.note: Kerrid: the anchor-fluke bites: iron chips and splinters.

snub_line.note: Kerrid: the line snubbed hard: rope fibres snapping.

anchor_fall.note: Kerrid: the anchor comes down: dust and stone.

reel_shot.note: Liss: the line strikes home, brass bright.

flash_housing.note: Liss: the lamp housing's flash in the foe's eyes (oil light; capped by particles, not a screen flash).

hoist_haul.note: Liss (Ch8): the hoist hauls a group up.

return_tide.note: Toma's Swell: the tide thrown back out from the stair.

written_light.note: Ysolde's Swell: written strokes of pale light across each foe (not glimmer).

floodnet.note: Ilun's Swell: a steady net of bound threads over each foe (bound light: no drift).

last_strike.note: Kahre's Swell: raw lightning down onto the foe.

flare_line.note: Virel's Swell: the kite-string burning, a flare on each foe.

tidal_ward.note: Ilun: water rising in a ring around itself.

kite_flare.note: Virel: a kite's flare drifting down on the foe.

tide_claw.note: A tide crawler's claw: the Undertow's light, sideways.

skim_bite.note: A skipper's bite out of the shallows.

gnaw.note: Hullgnaw's gnaw: the spawn's wound-light, sinking.

dive_rake.note: A gull's raking dive: pale feathers.

ladle_swing.note: The Cinder Matron's ladle: molten slag.

oil_slap.note: An oil slug slaps: black oil.

sail_drop.note: A sail leech drops over the target.

lure_glow.note: The lantern eel's lure: a cold glow.

brine_iron.note: The Inquisitor's brine-iron: a salt burn.

wing_dust.note: Ash shaken from a wing over each foe.

polyp_mend_hit.note: A polyp's held motes mend its ally (sinking, never rising).

shroud_sweep.note: The spar-wraith's shroud sweeps the party.

undertow_pull.note: The Reach pulls at the party's footing.

pull_in.note: A slag tortoise pulls into its shell.

bank_the_fire.note: The Cinder Matron banks her fire.

shell_wall.note: The Inquisitor's red shell armour closes.

reach_for_stair.note: A crawler reaches for the stair.

climb_up.note: The Climb: a group goes up the stair.

surge_crawler.note: The Surge throws up a crawler.

surge_wing.note: The Surge throws up a squall wing.

storm_call.note: Pell's storm-call strikes and drives a foe off.

brine_eyewash.note: Brine eyewash: clear water at the eyes (cleanse).

drag_net.note: The drag net thrown over a foe (delay).

relighting_wick.note: A relighting wick: a small oil flame lit again (revive; oil light, never glimmer).

vowbound_call.note: A Vowbound answers: a steady ring of bound light lifting around it.

vowbound_dismiss.note: A Vowbound leaves: its bound light settles.

vowbound_fell.note: A Vowbound falls: its bound light sinks (not a release).

haul.note: The Spar-Wraith hauls its spar down on a foe.

sea_lash.note: The Spar-Wraith lashes the party with the sea.

slag_pour.note: The Cinder Matron pours slag over the party.

torch_hulk.note: The Inquisitor torches the hulk: smoke over each foe.

breach.note: The Breach: the wall gives under the Reach.

recrust.note: The Cinder Matron's crust closes over her.

boss_hullgnaw_coil.note: Hullgnaw draws itself in: its wound-light gathers.

boss_hullgnaw_breaking.note: Hullgnaw's ribs break: bone and timber fall, the wound-light leaks out sideways.

boss_spawn_release.note: A spawn falls: the dead it held are let go, rising (released glimmer, color_script rule 1).

boss_wraith_hauled.note: The Spar-Wraith is hauled down: spars fall, its shroud tears and settles.

boss_matron_pour.note: The Matron turns to pouring: the ladle runs molten, smoke climbs.

boss_matron_fall.note: The Cinder Matron's fire banks for good: embers settle.

boss_inquisitor_torch.note: The Inquisitor torches the hulk: flame and smoke at his side.

boss_reach_gather.note: The Reach gathers itself against the wall.

boss_reach_dark.note: The storm-dark comes down over the wall-head.

boss_reach_breach.note: The Breach: the Reach's crust parts and its wound-light floods out sideways.

flood_surge.note: The Drownbell's flood surges over each foe.

undertow_surge.note: The Drownbell's undertow drags at each foe's feet.

swell_weighted_swing.note: Kerrid's Swell (the weighted swing): one flat, low sweep of iron across the foe at knee height, wet sand thrown out with it; never overhead, so it reads apart from Toma's blow.

swell_reel_stop.note: Liss's Swell (the reel-stop): the gadget's parts lock (a brass ring closing) and it goes off on the foe in a salt-glass flash; its light is bound glimmer, steady.

tick_poison.note: Poison takes its turn's toll: sick green welling out of the fighter.

tick_regen.note: Regen mends a little: shallow water lifting off (water, not glimmer).

tick_doom.note: A Doom count falls: a little dark settling.

tick_doom_fall.note: Doom comes due: the dark comes down whole.

tick_sleep.note: A turn lost to Sleep: slow pale motes drifting over the sleeper.

tick_stop.note: A turn lost to Stop: a still ring of salt-glass.

grip_the_stair.note: A crawler grips the stair head: wound-light clawing sideways, the climbers falter.

rope_dive.note: A squall wing dives the hand-line: spray and rope fibre whipped down across the stair.

hand_closes.note: The storm's hand closes on the stair head: the dark comes down whole, wound-light crushed out.

map.doc: Lookup order for each hit of an action: skills[skill_id] or items[item_id] (played once per target), then by what the hit did: damage plays elements[the skill's element], an HP restore plays events.heal, added statuses play events.status, and a KO plays events.ko. The opening plays events.ambush / events.preemptive when the battle starts.
map.ko_overrides_doc: Enemy ids whose KO plays another effect than events.ko (the Drownbell's motes are held: they slide seaward, they never rise).
